### Now we fit these co-variates and build global occupancy model

```{r}
library(unmarked)
library(MuMIn)
library(AICcmodavg)

library(dplyr)
library(sf)

# SINGLE SPECIES OCCUPANCY MODEL SELECTION & MODEL AVERAGING
# Great Hornbill, Arunachal Pradesh

det.cur <- read.delim("results/wh-det-cur-ready.txt") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(across(3:6, ~ifelse(. == 2, 1, .))) 

site.cov.selected <- read.delim("results/site-covariate-cur-ready.txt") %>% select(-grid.id)
exp_grid <- read.delim("results/exp-current.txt")
visit_grid <- read.delim("results/visit-current.txt")
prop_grid <- read.delim("results/prop-current.txt")

umf<- unmarkedFrameOccu(y = det.cur[,3:6],
                        siteCovs = site.cov.selected,
                        obsCovs = list(experience = exp_grid, 
                                       visit = visit_grid,
                                       proportion = prop_grid)
)     # creating unmarked occupancy data frame


# Global occupancy model
global_occ <- occu(~ agricuture + evergreen_deciduous_forest + experience + road_length + shifting_cultivation
                   ~ hunting.24 + shifting_cultivation + mean_elev 
                   + road_length + area_pa + evergreen_deciduous_forest
                   + canopy_height
                   + aspect + agricuture + X_populationmean.x,
                   data = umf)

summary(global_occ)

#Simplify Global Occupancy Model

```

### Global model fit check

```{r}
# fit check before proceeding
gof_occ <- mb.gof.test(global_occ, nsim = 1000, plot.hist = TRUE)
chat_occ <- gof_occ$c.hat.est

```

looks fine no violations, just that c_hat is close to 1, implying no
over dispersion

### Make the average model

```{r}
library(sf)

occ_dred <- readRDS("results/wh_occ_dred.rds")
occ_models <- get.models(occ_dred, subset = TRUE)
occ_model_table <- aictab(
  cand.set = occ_models,
  c.hat = 1,
  modnames = names(occ_models)
)
# GET TOP occupancy MODELS (cumulative weight <= 95)

# Build credible set (cumulative weight up to 0.95)
occ_credible_set <- occ_model_table %>%
  filter(Cum.Wt <= 0.95 & Delta_AICc <= 4)


top_occ_models <- get.models(occ_dred, subset = as.numeric(rownames(occ_credible_set)))

top_occ_models <- Filter(function(m) m@opt$convergence == 0, top_occ_models)

# Get occupancy predictions from your averaged model
library(AICcmodavg)
covariates <- read.table("prediction/all-grids-site-covariates-for-prediction.txt")
covariates[,c(2:10)] <- scale(covariates[,c(2:10)])


pred<- modavgPred(cand.set = top_occ_models,
newdata = covariates,
parm.type = "psi",
c.hat = 1,
untransformed = F)

# Add predictions to your grids shapefile
# load grids
grids <- st_read("spatial-data/final-grids-with-data-canopy.shp")
grids$psi_estimate <- pred$mod.avg.pred

# Check results
summary(grids$psi_estimate)

# Save as GeoPackage
st_write(grids, "results/rnh_grids_with_occupancy-estimate.kml")


```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(ggplot2)
library(sf)

# Load Arunachal Pradesh shapefile
arunachal <- st_read("spatial-data/arunachalpradeshshape.kml")

# Create map with state boundary
p_map <- ggplot() +
  # State boundary as background
  geom_sf(data = arunachal, fill = "gray95", color = "gray40", size = 0.8) +
  
  # Occupancy grids overlay
  geom_sf(data = grids, aes(fill = psi_estima), alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_viridis_b(name = "Occupancy (ψ)", limits = c(1, 0), direction = -1) +
  
  labs(title = "Oriental-pied Hornbill Occupancy Across AP") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

p_map
ggsave("figures/oph_occupancy_map_arunachal.png", plot = p_map, width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300)
```
